Net Profit  
•4Q2025: The Company reported net profit of THB 197.1 million, representing an increase of 3.8% from 
2024, with net profit margins of 20.5% and 20.6%, respectively. The increase in net profit was 
primarily due to lower finance costs and a higher share of profit from associates.  
 
•FY2025: The Company reported net profit of THB 783.9 million, representing a decrease of 9.0% from 
2024, with net profit margins of 20.3% and 22.1%, respectively. The declines in gross profit and net 
profit were in line with the decrease in revenue, while costs of rendering of services increased.  +3.8%
